body_text:
For finite-dimensional spaces,
$\ker T^*=(\operatorname{im}T)^\circ$ and
$\operatorname{im}T^*=(\ker T)^\circ$. These identities are the
dual form of rank--nullity and show precisely which linear
measurements vanish after passage through $T$.
